recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is for FHIR-18799. Any separate spelling cleanup for neighboring VaccineFundingProgram text should be handled under a separate tracker because no final Jira decision tied that text to this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-18799 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for the FHIR-core terminologies value set table entry immunization-program-eligibility, requesting the description spelling change from "patient's elibigility" to "patient's eligibility" with the intended phrase "vaccination program."
initial_application: The original legacy value set source was corrected by git commit 3711daf34c0bfd80da9afe8a6c468dcb2cc37d6e, which changed source/immunization/valueset-immunization-program-eligibility.xml from "elibigility" to "eligibility". That legacy value set file is no longer present in current core source.
additional_context: The current core source still has immunization as an active resource in source/fhir.ini and binds Immunization.programEligibility.programStatus to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/immunization-program-eligibility. Its active binding-definition text had drifted to "vaccation program", while Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later decision requiring different wording.
reconciliation: Changed source/immunization/structuredefinition-Immunization.xml so the ProgramEligibility binding-definition now says "The patient's eligibility for a vaccination program."
source_changes: source/immunization/structuredefinition-Immunization.xml: corrected the Immunization.programEligibility.programStatus ProgramEligibility binding-definition from "vaccation program" to "vaccination program".
